newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus offers up to 12 mln pounds 91-day t-bills.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus offers up to 12 mln pounds 91-day t-bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Cyprus will offer up to 12 million pounds ($25.6 million) in 91-day treasury bills with a December 27 issue date, the bank said on Wednesday.
Bids, which can be competitive or non-competitive, can be made from December 23 to 0900 local time (0700 GMT) on December 27.

Competitive bids will be accepted either in part or in whole if the price is equal or higher than that set by the central bank. Those making non-competitive bids will pay the average price of all bids submitted and accepted by the central bank.
Treasury bill auctions are held twice a month. ($=0.47 pounds)
